pmid.notes: Taken from provided paper_id field, which corresponds to the PubMed ID of this publication; not stated verbatim within the body text.

target_condition.evidence_quote: samples from four families with multiple cases of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM)

control.notes: Cohort contains both individuals with T1DM (Case) and healthy relatives (Study Control); no single study-level value applies. This field would need to be assigned per individual/sample.

country.evidence_quote: the National Commission for Data Protection in Luxembourg
country.notes: Study conducted at Centre Hospitalier de Luxembourg and Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine; all institutions located in Luxembourg.

body_site.evidence_quote: 53 well-preserved faecal samples collected over a period of two to four months
body_site.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures

days_from_first_collection.evidence_quote: collected over a period of two to four months
days_from_first_collection.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures
days_from_first_collection.notes: Only an overall collection window is given (2-4 months); exact days from first collection per sample are not reported in the visible text.

dna_extraction_kit.evidence_quote: extraction using the All-In-One kit (Norgen Biotek) to recover DNA and proteins were carried out as previously described
dna_extraction_kit.section: Methods — Extraction of biomolecular fractions from faecal samples
dna_extraction_kit.notes: DNA fractions were also supplemented with DNA extracted using the MOBIO Power Soil Kit ('DNA fractions were supplemented with DNA extracted from 200 mg subsamples using the MOBIO Power Soil Kit'); multiple kits were used, only the primary Norgen kit is reported here.

ncbi_accession.evidence_quote: Metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing reads can be accessed from NCBI BioProject PRJNA289586.
ncbi_accession.notes: This is a BioProject accession encompassing metagenomic/metatranscriptomic sequencing reads.

sequencing_platform.evidence_quote: DNA was sequenced with 101 bp (per paired end) on a HiSeq2000 system (Illumina) by BGI.
sequencing_platform.section: Methods — Metagenomic DNA and RNA sequencing
sequencing_platform.notes: Metatranscriptomic (RNA) libraries were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq2500 ('sequenced to 150 bp (per paired end) on an Illumina HiSeq2500 by Oxford Gene Technologies'); two different Illumina platforms were used for DNA vs RNA sequencing.

age.notes: Age data referenced as a factor considered (Supplementary Table 1) but not given numerically in the main text.

age_group.evidence_quote: four families of at least two generations presenting at least two cases of T1DM
age_group.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures
age_group.notes: Cohort spans at least two generations, implying both adult and possibly younger individuals, but no explicit age_group breakdown is given in the main text.

family.evidence_quote: The study cohort consisted of 20 individuals from four families of at least two generations
family.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures
family.notes: Four families (labelled M1-M4 in figures) are studied, but no single study-level family value applies; this is an individual-level attribute.

family_role.notes: Pedigrees show family roles (Fig. 1a) but individual role assignments are not tabulated in the visible text.

sex.evidence_quote: Female with T1DM Male with T1DM Female without T1DM Male without T1DM
sex.notes: Sex is denoted symbolically per individual in Fig. 1a but not reported as a study-level aggregate or per-subject table in the visible text.

zigosity.notes: Study describes family pedigrees, not twins; zygosity not applicable/reported.

age_min.notes: Specific ages not given in main text; referenced as in Supplementary Table 1, not provided.

age_max.notes: Specific ages not given in main text; referenced as in Supplementary Table 1, not provided.

age_years.notes: Ages mentioned only as families of at least two generations; no specific values in main text.

bmi.evidence_quote: Body mass index was calculated as kg m−2.
bmi.section: Methods — Anthropometric, nutritional, clinical data and blood and stool sampling
bmi.notes: Method for BMI calculation reported, but actual BMI values not given in main text (only referenced as a factor considered in Supplementary Table 1/Fig 14).

dietary_restriction.notes: No specific dietary restriction category (e.g., vegetarian) reported; only general similarity of diets noted.

disease.evidence_quote: samples from four families with multiple cases of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM)
disease.notes: Cohort includes both individuals with T1DM and healthy family members serving as controls.

by_subgroup.T1DM: type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM), diagnosed for more than five years, controlled by insulin replacement therapy
by_subgroup.Healthy: healthy family members, auto-antibody status did not indicate immediate risk of developing T1DM

disease_details.evidence_quote: T1DM was in all cases diagnosed for more than five years and successfully controlled by insulin replacement therapy
disease_details.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures

disease_response_orr.notes: Not applicable to this observational microbiome study.

disease_response_recist.notes: Not applicable (not an oncology treatment response study).

feces_phenotype.notes: Fecal samples analyzed for microbiome/proteome but no specific clinical stool phenotype (e.g., consistency) reported.

hla.notes: HLA haplotypes mentioned only in background/discussion about T1DM risk generally, not for specific participants.

neonatal_birth_weight.notes: Not applicable (adult/pediatric family cohort, not neonatal study).

treatment.evidence_quote: successfully controlled by insulin replacement therapy
treatment.section: Results — Study cohort and microbial community structures
treatment.notes: Applies to T1DM subgroup only; no treatment reported for healthy relatives.

biomarker_name.notes: Paper mentions measured human proteins (AMY2A, AMY2B, CPA1, CUZD1, LTF, ITLN1) and blood analytes (glucose, HbA1c, insulin, C-peptide, leptin, thiamine, etc.) but does not report specific quantitative biomarker values as a discrete list; only relative abundance patterns and correlations are described qualitatively or shown in figures.

biomarker_unit.notes: No explicit units for individual biomarker values reported in text; abundances shown only in figures (e.g., % relative protein abundance).

biomarker_value.notes: Specific numeric biomarker values not stated in the extractable text (only depicted graphically in Fig. 5a,b for AMY2A/AMY2B).

disease_response_os.notes: Study is a microbiome case study of familial T1DM; no survival/overall survival data reported.

ecog_performance_status.notes: Not applicable; not an oncology study with ECOG assessment.

feces_phenotype_value.notes: No explicit fecal phenotype value list reported (e.g., consistency score, pH); only microbial/proteomic composition described qualitatively.

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; paper concerns type 1 diabetes and gut microbiome, no tumor data.

Several schema fields (control, family, family_role, sex, age) vary across individuals within this multi-family cohort and cannot be reduced to a single study-level value; they are marked not_reported at study_level rather than fabricated.
study_name was derived using a standard naming convention (FirstAuthorSurnameInitial_Year) since it is not explicitly stated in the paper.

Two different DNA extraction kits (Norgen Biotek All-In-One kit and MOBIO Power Soil Kit) and two different Illumina platforms (HiSeq2000 for DNA, HiSeq2500 for RNA) were used; only one value could be reported per enum field, with the alternate noted.
Batch 1 returned granularity='subgroup_level', differs from batch 0 ('study_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups ['T1DM', 'Healthy'] differ from batch 0 []; kept batch 0.

Most demographic/clinical fields (age, BMI, HLA, diet specifics) are referenced as being detailed in Supplementary Table 1/Section 1, which was not included in the provided text; these were marked not_reported.
Schema fields largely pertain to oncology, neonatal, FMT, and reproductive contexts not relevant to this T1DM gut microbiome study; most are marked not_reported/not applicable.
